literal_meaning: জামাই ও পতির সংক্ষিপ্ত রূপ (স্বামী-স্ত্রীর যুগল)
figurative_meaning_bn: জায়া ও পতি, স্বামী ও স্ত্রী, মিথুনযুগল
example_sentences_in_english: Their married life is very happy.
The couple both work in offices.
note: This is a colloquial term commonly used in everyday Bengali speech to refer to a married pair.
